def _trend(x, degree):
    terms = [np.ones(len(x)), x]

    return np.column_stack(terms)


def _smooth(x, z, y, degree, family):

    U = np.linalg.qr(F, mode='complete')[0][:, F.shape[1]:]
    r = U.T @ y
    I = np.eye(len(r))
    diagonal = np.tril_indices(4, -1)
    pairs = [(i,j) for i in range(4) for j in range(i+1,4)]
    D = (x[:,None,:] - x[None,:,:])**2
